content.subject: Cloud cost discipline at Razorpay's scale
content.opening_hook: With Razorpay processing $60B+ in transactions and your team in Bengaluru now in a consolidation phase rather than headcount sprint, I'd imagine the pressure to squeeze more efficiency out of your AWS and Kafka infrastructure — without slowing platform delivery — is very real right now.
content.value_prop: We help platform engineering teams reduce cloud infrastructure spend significantly while keeping deployment velocity and observability intact across high-throughput, event-driven stacks like yours.
content.social_proof: For one pioneering fintech, we migrated 840+ scripts across 10+ business units to Amazon EMR, achieving ~50% platform cost reduction while maintaining scalability and performance.
content.cta: Would a focused 20-minute call next week make sense to explore whether there's a fit for Razorpay's infra footprint?
content.reasoning: Karan owns API gateway and developer infra at a high-scale fintech that's signaling consolidation (13.4% headcount growth, not hypergrowth). This points squarely to cost optimization pressure rather than build-out velocity. His stack — AWS, Kafka, Node.js, Redis, PostgreSQL — is well-matched to our EMR/cloud cost reduction proof point. The fintech social proof is directly relevant and credible. The angle avoids generic pitches and speaks specifically to the tension between maintaining platform reliability and reducing cloud spend during a phase of financial discipline.
content.body:
Hi Karan Bajaj,

I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

With Razorpay processing $60B+ in transactions and your team in Bengaluru now in a consolidation phase rather than headcount sprint, I'd imagine the pressure to squeeze more efficiency out of your AWS and Kafka infrastructure — without slowing platform delivery — is very real right now.

We help platform engineering teams reduce cloud infrastructure spend significantly while keeping deployment velocity and observability intact across high-throughput, event-driven stacks like yours.

For one pioneering fintech, we migrated 840+ scripts across 10+ business units to Amazon EMR, achieving ~50% platform cost reduction while maintaining scalability and performance.

Would a focused 20-minute call next week make sense to explore whether there's a fit for Razorpay's infra footprint?

With regards,
Ganit team
